senses.gloss:
औशिज औशिज, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. उशिज्), Ved.
desirous zealous, wishing; a patronymic of Kakṣīvat
and others; (अस्), m., N. of a Muni.

औषिज औषिज or औषीज, desirous &c.;
= औशिज above.

औशीनर औशीनर, अस्, ई, m. f. a prince of
the Uśīnaras; (ई), f. the wife of Purūravas.
औसीनरि, इस्, m. a prince of the Uśīnaras.

औशीर औशीर, अस्, अम्, m. n. (‘made of
Uśīra’), the stick which serves as a handle to the
cow's tail used as a fan or chowri; the cow's tail
used as a fan, the chowri; (अम्), n. a bed, used also
as a seat; a seat, a chair or stool; the root of a fra-
grant grass, Andropogon Muricatum; an unguent,
made of Uśīra.

औशीरिका, f. the shoot (of a plant); a basin, a
bowl.

औषिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. उषा), walking out at
day-break; early, matutinal, &c., with the dawn.
